headline: Bedford Design presented a conditional use permit for a 15,000 square foot supply building with an 11,529 square foot wetland buffer impact.
summary: The project would add a driveway off Cole Pocket Lane and a gravel wetland to treat stormwater from the parking areas. Ownership of Cole Pocket Lane, a private road, was questioned. A vote approved up to $500 for beaver control at Boutwell Road.
decisions: Approved up to $500 for beaver control at Boutwell Road, passed unanimously.
discussion: Supply building permit: Bedford Design's presentation said the 11,529 square foot buffer impact is for a driveway off Cole Pocket Lane and a gravel wetland that treats stormwater. Members asked who owns Cole Pocket Lane, a private road with an easement, and no clear answer was given; they asked that the plan show its ownership and add notes on snow storage and on not using salt.
Gravel wetland function: The presentation said the existing ditch mostly carries water, and the planned gravel wetland would add native plants and stormwater storage.

Beaver dam at Boutwell Road: Beavers are again causing problems near Boutwell Road and Garvin's bridge, affecting the Londonderry Country Club. Members discussed hiring a beaver control contractor, who was paid per beaver caught last time, and approved up to $500.

decision_evidence.quote: I make a motion that we uh authorize the chair to contract for up to $500 worth of beaver Control? ... all in favor? Aye. Aye. Opposed? Abstain? Motion passes unanimous.

decision_titles: Up to $500 for beaver control at Boutwell Road
